name: Umbra Ally

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Frequency once per hour

---
Regardless of the prevailing light conditions, your shadow begins to dance around your enemies, flummoxing their ability to defend themselves. Until the start of your next turn, your shadow darts around your foes, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach. Flanking with your shadow is the same as flanking with an ally and so is subject to effects like all-around vision or the deny advantage class feature.
